column1: # delegate registry: one delegation uid per repository (backends agy and codex share it).
# Columns: key<TAB>root<TAB>uid<TAB>setup<TAB>note[<TAB>agent uids]
#   key   : prefix of the workspace name. The workspace is <dirname(root)>/<key>-<backend>/ (e.g. /code/Projects/quad-agy)
#   root  : main repository path (working tree root)
#   uid   : from 61000 upward. No two repositories share a uid, so a task in one cannot modify the other's worktree.
#           It must not collide with a real user in /etc/passwd (`doctor` checks). agy runs as this uid, and so does
#           every agent the last column does not name.
#   setup : command run once inside the new worktree right after it is created (`-` for none). Failure only warns.
#           delegate.sh runs it as root; delegate.py runs it as the task uid with the task's environment plus mise.
#   note  : free text for humans (`-` when the last column follows)
#   agent uids : optional, read by delegate.py only, e.g. `codex=61004`: that agent's own uid, so agy and codex of one
#           repository run side by side without reaching each other's files. Rows without it share the uid column.
# A new repository gets the next free uids from `delegate.py register <root>`; on a row without the last column the same
# command adds it. `delegate.sh register` counts only the uid column and may hand out a uid the last column already
# uses, so register with delegate.py once that column exists. Edit by hand only while no delegation is running.
# This file is edited in place, so HARNESS_DELEGATE_REGISTRY must point at the git clone copy, not a plugin cache copy.
